text:
sara: Received from customer AcmeCorp — intermittent 403s after they rotated keys. They included a curl that reproduces:

sara: ```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." -H "X-Org-Id: org-acme" -H "X-Project-Id: proj-legacy" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
``` 

sara: Response headers show x-request-id=req_0a1b2c3d, body: {"error":"Forbidden","code":403}

tim: Can you confirm whether they rotated an org-scoped key vs project-scoped? :thinking:

kevin: Quick repro attempt — I swapped X-Project-Id with X-Org-Id and hit 403 locally. Looks like header order doesn't matter but scope mismatch does.

ingrid: Share the exact request-id and a small server log snippet for that req_0a1b2c3d, please. Ask them to send a debug bundle (curl --trace-ascii or HAR) and the token kid.

sara: They provided kid: KID:abc123, token looks like org-scoped JWT (sub=service:acme:org-acme). Customer says backend used a project-level RBAC binding.

kevin: My local logs for the swapped header attempt:

kevin: ```
[2025-10-23T14:02:11.123Z] req=req_0a1b2c3d auth=FAIL reason="scope_mismatch" token_kid=abc123 org=org-acme project=proj-legacy
[2025-10-23T14:02:11.124Z] handler=auth verifier=jwt status=403
```

tim: Repro steps for support to send back to customer:

tim: 1) curl with header X-Org-Id=<org> and X-Project-Id=<project> where token is org-scoped -> 403

tim: 2) curl removing X-Project-Id or using project-scoped token -> 200

tim: Example to demonstrate (replace token):

Tim: ```bash
# expected 403
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci..." -H "X-Org-Id: org-acme" -H "X-Project-Id: proj-legacy" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat

# expected 200 (remove project header)
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci..." -H "X-Org-Id: org-acme" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```

ingrid: Also ask them to paste the full JWT header+payload (not private key) and the exact x-request-id from their failing call. We need both the token.kid and the header trace to match logs.

sara: Customer sent debug bundle via secure link. I pulled trace id trace-x9z and attached minimal log from their environment.

support-bot: debug-bundle-ingested: trace=trace-x9z request=req_0a1b2c3d

kevin: Verified in prod logs: token_kid matches but enforcement path shows org-level token being validated against project binding -> returns 403. Looks like a recent change in auth-router introduced stricter matching on org vs project scope.

tim: I'll open a short rollback PR on auth-router to relax the check and add a regression test. Assigning @kevin to triage regression. :thumbsup:

sara: Thanks — I'll update customer with repro steps and ETA for fix. Keep channel posted.
